method: Clone verify AST only, record every must site, then remove one must call in a separate in-memory function. Package/helper/schema/hash checks stay active. Never alter sealed or installed runtime bytes. Specific-code kills and newly accepted negatives are reported separately.

mutations.expression: type(source_bytes) is dict and type(schema_bytes) is dict
isc['schemaId'] in foreign and 'sha256:' + p['schemaDigests'][isc['schemaId']] == isc['schemaDigest']
len({x['pathId'] for x in paths}) == len(paths)
all((tuple_key(path) <= tuple_key(other) for other in paths if other['pathDisposition'] == 'PATH_ALLOW'))
sid not in [x['$id'] for x in owned.values()]
f['schemaId'] in foreign and f['schemaSha256'] == p['schemaDigests'][f['schemaId']]
identity not in identities or identities[identity] == entry['bytesSha256']
x['role'] == 'ADDITIONAL_AUTHORITY_BASIS' or x['role'] not in roles
any((equal(z, expected) for z in snap['visibleBasis']))
env['requestedActionClass'] == rs['actionClass'] and env['authorizationDecisionResultRef'] == rs['resultId'] and (env['authorizationDecisionTraceRef'] == rs['traceId'])
rev['executingAgentInstanceRef'] == principal and rev['agentSponsorRef'] == rid('SPONSOR_PARTY') and (rev['authorityEnvelopeRef'] == rid('CP3_AUTHORITY_ENVELOPE'))
'$dynamicRef' not in v and '$recursiveRef' not in v
any((equal(source_binding, x['binding']) and x['artifactFamily'] in ['AUTHORITY_GRANT', 'DELEGATION_GRANT', 'SHARING_GRANT'] for x in candidate['basis']))

rec[principal_field] == principal and rec['agentSponsorRef'] == rid('SPONSOR_PARTY') and (rec['softwareAgentProfileRef'] == rid('SOFTWARE_AGENT_PROFILE')) and (rec['authoritySnapshotRef'] == rid('CP3_AUTHORITY_SNAPSHOT'))
party == rid('REPRESENTED_PARTY') and rep['naturalPersonPartyRef'] == rid('NATURAL_PERSON_PARTY') and (rep['representedPartyRef'] == party)
party == rid('REPRESENTED_PARTY') and dg['delegatingPartyRef'] == party and (dg['delegatePartyRef'] == rid('AGENT_PARTY'))
any((equal(b, rb('DELEGATION_GRANT')) for b in path['delegationSourceBindings']))
any((x['artifactFamily'] == 'AUTHORITY_GRANT' and x['binding']['ref'] == source_ref for x in basis))

next: Review unwitnessed and redundant checks explicitly; do not claim exhaustive mutation coverage.
